headline: Christiane Amanpour to Depart CNN After 43 Years
summary: Veteran international anchor Christiane Amanpour announced she is leaving CNN after 43 years. The news follows CNN parent's acquisition by David Ellison's Skydance Media, though her exit is reportedly unrelated.
why: CNN is a major global cable news network owned by Warner Bros. Discovery, currently undergoing structural changes under new media ownership.
